title: BP Energy Outlook 2030
scenario_note: bp calls it the 'most likely' base case. Alternatives: business-as-usual (China at trend intensity), Policy Case.

entries.subject: oil
entries.metric: global liquids demand (oil, biofuels and other liquids)
entries.quote: Global liquids demand (oil, biofuels, and other liquids) nonetheless is likely to rise by 16 Mb/d, exceeding 103 Mb/d by 2030.

entries.subject: renewables
entries.quote: By 2030 renewables supply 11% of world electricity.
entries.note: Share of electricity, not primary energy.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: plug-in vehicle share of new vehicle sales
entries.quote: Sales of plug-in vehicles, including full battery electric vehicle (BEVs), are forecast to be 8% of sales in 2030.
entries.note: Sales share, not a fleet count.

notes: No summary tables found. Renewables share of primary energy not stated in text (only share of electricity). No EV count; plug-in share of sales given.
